# bizkit_project (Data Source)

A project of the workspace, found by `id` or `slug`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bizkit_project" "website" {
  slug = "website"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `slug` (String) The URL-safe name.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The display name.
